request.query: zeroth higher divided derivative is identity linear endomorphism

items.name: iteratedDeriv_zero
items.type:
∀ {𝕜 : Type u_1} [inst : NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {F : Type u_2} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup F]
  [inst_2 : NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {f : 𝕜 → F}, iteratedDeriv 0 f = f

items.name: LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv_zero
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] {V : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : Module R V],
  LaurentSeries.hasseDeriv R 0 = LinearMap.id

items.name: iteratedDeriv_fun_id
items.type:
∀ {𝕜 : Type u_1} [inst : NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {n : ℕ} {x : 𝕜},
  iteratedDeriv n (fun a => a) x = if n = 0 then x else if n = 1 then 1 else 0

items.name: Polynomial.hasseDeriv_zero
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R], Polynomial.hasseDeriv 0 = LinearMap.id

items.name: iteratedDerivWithin_zero
items.type:
∀ {𝕜 : Type u_1} [inst : NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] {F : Type u_2} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup F]
  [inst_2 : NormedSpace 𝕜 F] {f : 𝕜 → F} {s : Set 𝕜}, iteratedDerivWithin 0 f s = f
